normative_plan: SD §6 Agora design, §12.4, GAP-AGORA-01, GAP-AGORA-02, GAP-AGORA-03, GAP-AGORA-05, GAP-AGORA-06; pkt-pantheon-structural-closure-functional-v2-20260903

implementation.receipt_and_provenance_architecture: Fail-closed schema, version, terminal status, owner, and correlation validation in receipt.py and routes/common.py. Unreceipted runs never return 'real' (resolving to 'fixture' or 'simulation'). Non-terminal runs, absent receipts, missing receipt_id/completed_at, spec_version != '1.0', wrong owner, or wrong correlation return 'unavailable'. AuthenticStageAdapter in real mode strictly validates backend terminal outputs, rejecting missing, non-terminal, or failed outputs, and never rewrites observed simulation/fixture provenance into real mode. Negative controls suite (test_agora_authentic_adapter_negative_controls.py) proves fail-closed behavior across missing backend outputs, non-terminal status, failed execution outcomes, mode forgery/mismatch, invalid receipt schemas, missing artifact digests, and missing backend references.
implementation.execution_owner_and_receipt_recording: Authentic execution owner (AuthenticStageAdapter in dispatcher.py) accepts an execution_owner or execute_fn and fails closed when absent in 'real' mode. It invokes the real backend, reads back execution receipt/metrics, and enforces that metric/evidence provenance matches execution mode. AgoraInteractionWorker launcher (scripts/run_agora_interaction_worker.py) and docker-compose.yml wire AGORA_RESEARCH_STORE_BACKEND/DSN/SCHEMA, build_authentic_adapter_registry(), and fail fast on unconstructable stores or clients. Durability is backed by Postgres or persistent store snapshotting across worker restarts, verified by test_e2e_bff_enqueue_separate_worker_restart_persistence.
implementation.correlation_chain: Single continuous correlation chain (trace_id / correlation_id) wired across Workshop messages/events, ResearchExecutionReceipt, candidate pool members admitted via CandidatePoolCreateRequest, Trading Room decisions (TraderDecisionRequest), Outbox handoffs (GovernedIntentHandoffRequest), and telemetry-triggered AdjustmentSuggestions via canonical ThresholdTelemetryIncidentConsumer.
implementation.performance_suggestion_consumer: Attached EvaluationTelemetryConsumer to canonical ThresholdTelemetryIncidentConsumer without adding any new background scheduler. Wired CanonicalPerformanceEventTransport with acknowledged delivery: unacknowledged events when no subscribers are active are not marked published; outage failures propagate without marking published and successfully recover on replay; retry-safe durable identity prevents duplicate events. In incidents service, suggestions are durably stored in isolated incident-data volume (/data/incidents/agora_performance.sqlite3) and queried by BFF over HTTP (PANTHEON_INCIDENTS_API_URL), eliminating shared/injected SQLite across containers.

mandatory_deletions.client_supplied_real_provenance_flags: Deleted routing.get('backend_mode', 'real') default in _build_run_projection; initial projection defaults to unavailable until authentic ResearchExecutionReceipt is recorded and validated.
mandatory_deletions.fake_synchronous_terminal_fallbacks: Removed fake synchronous completion assumptions; dispatch leaves runs in queued state for outbox worker consumption; verified fail-closed lease, retry, DLQ, and crash recovery mechanics without fake synchronous fallback.
mandatory_deletions.manual_only_suggestion_production: Replaced manual suggestion injection with EvaluationTelemetryConsumer attached to canonical ThresholdTelemetryIncidentConsumer.

implementation.rollback_plan: Disable new consumers and deploy the prior exact paper-safe release without deleting canonical receipts.
